plot_transformer: plot transformer validation loss (NLL) vs optimization steps and save as PDF
plot_itrs: plot training or validation error over time for distributed SGD algorithms across nodes
plot_scaling: plot time per iteration vs number of nodes for scaling analysis across networks
parse_transformer_out: parse transformer training output files and return a DataFrame with iterations, PPL, NLL, and time
parse_csv: parse CSV result files for distributed training and return a DataFrame with train, val, and time stats
